messages.subject: Workspace in right sidebar by default
messages.subject_clean: Workspace in right sidebar by default
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,


I am switching from RStudio to using RKward. I want to move the workspace to the right sidebar, but when I do so and I close the program, when I open it the workspace is back in the left sidebar. Is there a way to make it permanent in the right sidebar ?


Using RKward 0.6.4


Thank you.

messages.body_plain:
Hi,

On Wed, 17 May 2017 17:04:17 +0000
Georgios x <br_shadow at msn.com> wrote:
> I am switching from RStudio to using RKward. I want to move the
> workspace to the right sidebar, but when I do so and I close the
> program, when I open it the workspace is back in the left sidebar. Is
> there a way to make it permanent in the right sidebar ?

seems like a reasonable expectatiion, and in fact I had to check,
myself, whether the feature was just well-hidden, broken, or
non-existent. Turns out it was the latter...

It will take more that just a few lines of code, though, so I have
added it to the tracker, for now:
https://bugs.kde.org/show_bug.cgi?id=380020? The top priority right now
it to finish a first version based on KF5 (aka "KDE 5").

> Using RKward 0.6.4

Note that the current version of RKWard is 0.6.5. Chances are you
will be able to install this, without upgrading any other parts of your
system. See https://rkward.kde.org/Download_RKWard

Regards
Thomas
